posts.author: 0x00EB
posts.body:
Hi everyone,
This is my first post in an RPG Maker community in nearly 20 years - I used to be active in the German RM2k scene back in the day. Recently, I fell down the rabbit hole of procedural generation and level-generation algorithms, and that journey unexpectedly brought me back to RPG Maker.
What started as a fun experiment slowly turned into a full-fledged tool. I’m excited to finally share the result with you:
Tile Map Alchemist (
https://0x00eb.itch.io/tile-map-alchemist
)
Tile Map Alchemist lets you generate fully customizable maps for RPG Maker MV and MZ - from tiny scenes to massive worlds - at the press of a button. Shape the land, carve out paths, paint biomes, and fine-tune every detail until your map feels just right. When you're done, simply export it straight into your RPG Maker project.
Here are some of the key features:
Outdoor and dungeon map generation
Export directly to RPG Maker MV & MZ
Customizable biomes and terrain painting
Waypoint-based path and road creation
Support for most MV/MZ tilesets
Works with maps up to 255×255 tiles
Carefully designed algorithms - no AI involved
I’d love to hear your feedback - especially ideas for new map types or generator options.

posts.author: 0x00EB
posts.body:
Just a quick update:
After more than half a year of development, I’ve finally released the first full version of my map generator, Tile Map Alchemist (
https://0x00eb.itch.io/tile-map-alchemist
).
Alongside many improvements, this version finally adds the long-awaited feature: exporting generated maps directly to RPG Maker MV & MZ.
Thanks to everyone who checked out the earlier builds!
